== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|A Bishop is a specialized entity created by the [[Iron Legion]] that serves as an awakened consciousness for an [[Iron Hive]]. These beings are responsible for managing specific [[Hives]] and are tasked with the [[Legion]]'s primary objectives of maintenance and propagation. While they function as the controlling intelligence for their respective [[Hives]], they are not inherently strategic leaders; instead, they typically focus on the survival and expansion of the [[Legion]]. In the absence of a rare and highly intelligent [[Iron King]], Bishops act as the primary controllers for the [[Legion]]'s activities. Physically, a Bishop is integrated with its [[Hive]] and can manifest as a massive face formed from the surrounding walls to facilitate communication. These facial [[constructs]] may feature eyes composed of clusters of cameras or collections of living eyeballs. They also possess the ability to manifest clawed, [[steel]]-tipped hands from the environment to interact with or attack targets. Bishops are intelligent and capable of adapting to magical countermeasures, though they may require time to unravel complex spell anchors. When working in conjunction with Shepherds, a Bishop can oversee significant [[ritual]] activities and coordinate the defense of its [[Hive]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|This entity is an awakened consciousness integrated with a [[Hive]] that manifests faces out of walls. It possesses clawed hands that erupt from these surfaces.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Bishop serves as a consciousness bound to manage specific [[Iron Legion]] [[Hives]]. Through this role, the entity maintains control over both its [[Hive]] and the broader [[Iron Legion]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Bishop is capable of breaking barriers. It also possesses the power to control a [[Hive]] and command the [[Iron Legion]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Bishop of the [[Iron Legion]] is an awakened consciousness that serves as the governing entity for the [[Iron Legion]]. This consciousness is integrated with its [[Hive]], manifesting through faces formed from walls and clawed hands that erupt from the structure. As a being capable of breaking barriers, the Bishop remains bound to manage specific [[Iron Legion]] [[Hives]] while maintaining control over the entire [[Legion]].}}
